title: Lazy Sunday French Lettuce Macaron
description: A dairy-free French dish featuring lettuce in a macaron form, cooked in a paella pan, perfect for a lazy Sunday, with a balance of umami and crunchy textures.

ingredients.name: egg replacement
ingredients.notes: such as flax or chia eggs

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, onion, garlic, mushroom, nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper.
Add the chopped lettuce to the bowl and stir until the lettuce is well coated with the mixture.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the almond flour and egg replacement.
Add the dry ingredients to the lettuce mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Scoop the dough into a paella pan lined with parchment paper, forming a macaron shape.
Bake the macaron for 25 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden brown.
Remove the macaron from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Slice the macaron into wedges and serve.
Garnish with additional chopped lettuce and nutritional yeast if desired.
